title: P2Patch: Exploit-Guided Vulnerability Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.20245v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for automated program repair, patching software vulnerabilities through multi-step reasoning and tool use. Yet these systems typically validate a patch against the same evidence used to construct it -- a static alert, sanitizer trace, published exploit, or test suite. A patch that blocks that one piece of evidence can therefore look successful while remaining vulnerable to the same vulnerability with some variation. We present P2Patch, a generative adversarial repair system that treats each patch as a new attack target. Starting from a normalized vulnerability finding, an exploitation agent constructs a reproducing proof of vulnerability (PoV), a patching agent repairs the program, and the exploitation agent then attacks the patched program for a distinct same-vulnerability exploit. translated_title: P2Patch：基于漏洞利用引导的漏洞修复
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.20245v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：大语言模型正日益被部署为自动化程序修复的自主智能体，通过多步推理和工具使用来修补软件漏洞。然而，这些系统通常使用与构建补丁时相同的证据来验证补丁——静态告警、消毒器（sanitizer）追踪记录、已公开的漏洞利用代码或测试套件。因此，一个仅能阻断该特定证据的补丁可能看起来是成功的，但面对同一漏洞的某些变体时仍然存在漏洞。我们提出了P2Patch，一个生成式对抗修复系统，它将每个补丁视为新的攻击目标。从一个规范化的漏洞发现开始，漏洞利用智能体构建可复现的漏洞证明（PoV），补丁智能体修复程序，随后漏洞利用智能体针对打过补丁的程序发起同一漏洞的不同利用攻击。每一次成功的漏洞利用都会成为永久的修复要求，最终的补丁……
tldr: P2Patch提出了一种生成式对抗修复系统，通过漏洞利用智能体与补丁智能体的持续对抗，将每次成功的漏洞利用转化为永久修复要求，从而生成能抵御同一漏洞多种变体攻击的更稳健补丁。
en_tdlr: P2Patch presents a generative adversarial repair system where an exploitation agent repeatedly attacks patched programs with distinct exploits of the same vulnerability, turning every successful exploit into a permanent repair requirement to produce more robust patches.
